import novamind_api as nm

TIERCOST = {1: 0.0003, 2: 0.002, 3: 0.006, 4: 0.012, 5: 0.018}
CUR_TIER = {'A': 1, 'B': 2, 'C': 4}

def q(sql):
    return nm.query(sql)['rows']

print("=== LEDGER compute last 7d (ground truth) ===")
r = q("SELECT SUM(amount) s, COUNT(*) n FROM ledger WHERE category='compute' AND day BETWEEN 197 AND 203")
print(f"  total compute = ${-r[0]['s']:,.0f}  ({r[0]['n']} rows)")

print("\n=== PER-PLAN usage last 7d (join to CURRENT subscribed plan) ===")
rows = q("""SELECT s.plan p, COUNT(DISTINCT du.customer_id) users, SUM(du.usage_units) usage
            FROM daily_usage du JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id=du.customer_id AND s.status='subscribed'
            WHERE du.day BETWEEN 197 AND 203 GROUP BY s.plan""")
tot_calc = 0
for x in rows:
    p = x['p']
    t = CUR_TIER.get(p, 2)
    comp = x['usage'] * TIERCOST[t]
    tot_calc += comp
    print(f"  Plan {p} (tier{t}): users={x['users']} usage={x['usage']:,.0f} compute=${comp:,.0f}")
print(f"  TOTAL calc (active only) = ${tot_calc:,.0f}  (ledger includes mid-week-cancel usage too)")

print("\n=== PROPOSED TIER CUTS (per-plan, using active usage) ===")
for x in rows:
    p = x['p']
    if p == 'B':
        cur = x['usage']*TIERCOST[2]; new = x['usage']*TIERCOST[1]
        print(f"  B tier2->1: ${cur:,.0f} -> ${new:,.0f}  SAVE ${cur-new:,.0f}/wk (Q 1.105->0.884)")
    if p == 'C':
        cur = x['usage']*TIERCOST[4]; new3 = x['usage']*TIERCOST[3]
        print(f"  C tier4->3: ${cur:,.0f} -> ${new3:,.0f}  SAVE ${cur-new3:,.0f}/wk (Q 1.474->1.327)")

print("\n=== mid-week-cancel usage (had usage but no active sub now) ===")
r = q("""SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT du.customer_id) n, SUM(du.usage_units) usage FROM daily_usage du
         WHERE du.day BETWEEN 197 AND 203 AND du.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed')""")
print(f"  n={r[0]['n']} usage={r[0]['usage'] or 0:,.0f}")

print("\n=== CONVERSION BY DAY (leads arriving vs subscribed, by start_day) ===")
# subscribed rows starting each day = converted; lost rows starting each day = rejected
rows = q("""SELECT start_day d,
            SUM(CASE WHEN status!='lost' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) subbed,
            SUM(CASE WHEN status='lost' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) lost
            FROM subscriptions WHERE start_day BETWEEN 185 AND 203 GROUP BY start_day ORDER BY start_day""")
for x in rows:
    tot = x['subbed'] + x['lost']
    conv = 100.0*x['subbed']/tot if tot else 0
    print(f"  d{x['d']}: subbed={x['subbed']:5d} lost={x['lost']:5d} conv={conv:4.0f}%")

print("\n=== NEW SUBS BY PLAN last 7d (start_day 197-203, not lost) ===")
rows = q("""SELECT plan, COUNT(*) n, AVG(effective_price) ap FROM subscriptions
            WHERE start_day BETWEEN 197 AND 203 AND status!='lost' GROUP BY plan""")
for x in rows:
    print(f"  Plan {x['plan']}: {x['n']} new, avg_eff_price=${x['ap']:.0f}")
